_comment: Interior room template (PROCGEN_INTERIOR.md §8). Backs both the 'C++: Generate Room' spell and the generate_interior adapter action. base = '0x..~Skyrim.esm' (FormUtil::Parse, deterministic) or a vanilla EditorID (LookupByEditorID). pos/grid in LOCAL frame relative to the room origin (anchorDistance units in front of the caster). rot_deg in DEGREES (adapter converts to radians). motion: fixed|keyframed|dynamic. STRATEGY (per PROCGEN_INTERIOR.md): vanilla interior SHELL kits only snap precisely in the CK, so this recipe leans on REAL freestanding furniture + clutter + flat rug 'floor' pieces rather than a perfectly-snapped wall shell. Every FormID is a real vanilla form; unknown/mistyped ids log a warning and are skipped (no crash). Exact placement (overlap/float/sit-marker reachability) still needs in-game tuning.

shell._comment: Flat rugs used as a visible 'floor' footprint (2x2 grid). Rugs are flat STATs that need no precise edge-snap, so they read as a room floor without a CK-snapped shell. 0x000B7E3E = long green rug (VERIFIED console code, eldersouls furnishing guide). grid coords * grid_step (256) -> local units.
0x00095498 = round green rug (VERIFIED console code, eldersouls). A second rug style breaks up the floor.

furniture_slots._comment: Common bed against the back of the room. 0x000FEDBF = common bed (VERIFIED console code, eldersouls 'Common' bed). Has a sleep marker (rides the NIF), so the player can sleep in it. usable=true.
Noble round table in the centre. 0x000C29DE = noble round table (VERIFIED console code, eldersouls 'Noble (round)' table).

Two wooden chairs flanking the table. 0x0003B46F = standard wooden chair (VERIFIED console code, eldersouls 'Standard wooden' chair). Has a sit marker; the player can sit. _todo: chair facing/offset vs the round table needs in-game nudging.
A farmhouse bench by the wall for variety. 0x000A4AD6 = farm bench (VERIFIED console code, eldersouls 'farm' bench).

lights._comment: Candlelight to brighten the room. PREFERRED here is a light-EMITTING form: DefaultCandleLight01NS is a known vanilla TESObjectLIGH EditorID that carries a light (research/PROCGEN_INTERIOR.md §3.3 / §8). Confidence MEDIUM — EditorID not 100% verifiable from web; resolves via LookupByEditorID and is SKIPPED with a warning if absent (no crash).

Backup visible light: 0x000B9FAD = tall white candle STATIC (VERIFIED console code, eldersouls). This is a model with a candle flame; it adds a visible candle even if the light-emitting EditorID above misses. Placed on the table.

clutter._comment: Tankards scattered on the table AABB (count + seed -> deterministic scatter, JSON-driven path). Tankard01 is a known vanilla MISC EditorID (research §3.2). Confidence MEDIUM — EditorID; resolves via LookupByEditorID, skipped with a warning if absent. AABB is centred over the table top (~z=96).

navmesh_note: Generated area has NO runtime navmesh; NPCs cannot path here (NAVMESH_FREE_PATHFINDING.md). The player can walk and use placed furniture (sit/sleep markers ride the NIF).
_confidence: VERIFIED (console-tested codes, eldersouls furnishing guide cross-checked): rugs 0x000B7E3E / 0x00095498, bed 0x000FEDBF, table 0x000C29DE, chair 0x0003B46F, bench 0x000A4AD6, candle 0x000B9FAD. MEDIUM (EditorID, not web-verifiable, skipped-if-absent): DefaultCandleLight01NS, Tankard01.
